lines.en: label christmasfive4:
scene malvinstree
{b}HELLO{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你好{/b}

lines.en: {b}WELCOME TO CHRISTMAS{/b}
lines.zh: {b}欢迎来到圣诞节{/b}

lines.en: {b}Today is December 25th, 2020.{/b}
{b}You have been here before on many occasions. But there is nothing particularly special about the second half of the date.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你以前来过这里很多次。但这个日期的后半部分并没有什么特别之处。{/b}

lines.en: {b}Today, you will be joined by three angels who will watch over you.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}今天,将有三位天使与你同行,看护着你。{/b}

lines.en: {b}Their names are Malvin, Diamond, and Spork.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}他们的名字是 Malvin、Diamond 和 Spork。{/b}

lines.en: {b}Malvin is a mischievous monk. He’s always sleeping in and stealing the laces from your left shoe.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}Malvin 是个调皮的修道士。他总是睡过头,还老偷你左脚鞋子的鞋带。{/b}

lines.en: {b}Diamond is a good boy. You appreciate and relate to his impaired vision. But he is a spiteful monk, and will stop at nothing to get what he wants.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}Diamond 是个好孩子。你很欣赏,也很能体会他那受损的视力。可他是个记仇的修道士,为了得到想要的东西,什么都做得出来。{/b}

lines.en: {b}Spork is the youngest. A glutton, he is. But he has yet to learn right from wrong, so his advice should be taken with a grain of rice.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}Spork 是最小的那个。他是个贪吃鬼。可他还没学会分辨对错,所以他的建议应该配着一粒米饭一起听。{/b}

lines.en: {b}This song will play on repeat for the rest of the game. It is the only way to fix you.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}这首歌会在接下来的整场游戏里循环播放。这是修复你的唯一方法。{/b}

lines.en: {b}Our records indicate that Akira Arakawa (You) is shouldering the great burden of childhood trauma.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我们的记录显示,Akira Arakawa(你)正背负着童年创伤这一沉重负担。{/b}

lines.en: {b}To remedy this, we have hired a team of microscopic, invisible spelunkers to dive into the depths of his (Your) mind and retrieve relics of his (Your) past that may remind him (You) of brighter days.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}为了解决这个问题,我们雇了一队微小而隐形的洞穴探险者,潜入他(你)心灵的深处,取回他(你)过去的遗物,那些或许能让他(你)想起更明亮的日子的东西。{/b}

lines.en: {b}Picture this — a tree. The tree belongs to Malvin.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}想象一下——一棵树。这棵树属于 Malvin。{/b}

lines.en: {b}He is your best friend. And he has convinced you to open your presents early.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}他是你最好的朋友。而他说服你提前拆开了礼物。{/b}

lines.en: {b}So you tear into the first one with reckless abandon, mutilating the carefully arranged paper colored red and gold which serves as the skin.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}于是你不管不顾地撕开第一个礼物,把那层精心包装、红金相间、充当皮肤的纸撕得稀烂。{/b}

lines.en: {b}It feels a bit like sex, you think. But you have only heard about that through the tongues of those who never come upstairs, so you’re not sure if you can take their words as gospel.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你觉得这感觉有点像做爱。可你只是从那些从不上楼的人的舌头上听说过这种事,所以你不确定能不能把他们的话当真。{/b}

lines.en: {b}You look inside the box, now butchered. The box, not you. But what you find is no gift at all. It is a clock.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你往盒子里看——现在被开膛破肚的是盒子,不是你。可你看到的根本不是什么礼物。是一只钟。{/b}

lines.en: {b}There are no hands on the clock — just thirteen numbers.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}钟上没有指针——只有十三个数字。{/b}

lines.en: {b}But what is this extra one?{/b}
lines.zh: {b}可这多出来的一个是什么?{/b}

lines.en: {b}You reach forward and touch it. Or at least you try to. Malvin suddenly has to leave.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你伸手去碰它。至少你试了。Malvin 突然得走了。{/b}

lines.en: scene sky
show malvin
: I suddenly have to leave!
lines.zh: : 我突然得走了!

lines.en: : Why is that, Malvin?
lines.zh: : 这是为什么,Malvin?

lines.en: : I have to feed Spork. A glutton, he is. And I don’t even want to think about what Diamond will put in his mouth if I’m late again.
lines.zh: : 我得去喂 Spork。他是个贪吃鬼。而且我连想都不敢想,要是我又迟到,Diamond 会把什么东西塞进他嘴里。

lines.en: : But it’s Christmas. Can’t you stay and find out what the thirteenth number does with me?
lines.zh: : 可今天是圣诞节。你就不能留下来,跟我一起看看那第十三个数字会做什么吗?

lines.en: : Not now. But I’ll be right back to chauffeur you through this jolliest of days once dinner has been completed.
lines.zh: : 现在不行。不过等晚饭结束,我马上回来,当你的司机,载你穿过这最欢乐的一天。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Akira! You will have to face the party on your own for now!
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Akira!现在你得先独自面对这场派对了!

lines.en: : But you’ve done it so many times before. Just act normal.
lines.zh: : 可你以前已经做过很多次了。表现得正常点就行。

lines.en: : {b}AND DON’T LET THEM KNOW YOU TALK TO MONKS.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}还有,别让他们知道你会跟修道士说话。{/b}

lines.en: : Oh, good.
lines.zh: : 哦,好耶。

lines.en: : It’s going to be one of {i}those{/i} days, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 今天会是{i}那种{/i}日子,对吧?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf1
: I think you’ll be fine, Sensei. That one only lasted for a minute or two.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没事的,Sensei。刚才那次只持续了一两分钟。

lines.en: : You don’t need a recap, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不需要我复述一遍吧?

lines.en: A voice in your head that you put there because you were lonely reminds you to not let her know you talk to monks.
lines.zh: 你因为寂寞而放进脑子里的那个声音提醒你:别让她知道你会跟修道士说话。

lines.en: You spelunk into your own mind and manage to retrieve what she’s looking for.
lines.zh: 你潜入自己的脑海,成功取回了她在找的东西。

lines.en: : How many times did I cum inside of you today?
lines.zh: : 我今天在你里面射了几次?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf2
: Five.
lines.zh: : 五次。

lines.en: : I think I need to go the hospital. I only remember four.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我得去医院了。我只记得四次。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf3
: I think you’ll be fine. And I’d offer to help you increase the count {i}now,{/i} but we’re kind of short on time. The party’s already started.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没事。我倒是想{i}现在{/i}就帮你把次数往上加一加,可我们时间有点紧。派对已经开始了。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf4
: You look around to find that you’re at Tsukioka Manor. The grounds are filled with Christmas trees of the wrong color, indicating that the family possesses a lack of understanding of the holiday.
lines.zh: : 你环顾四周,发现自己在 Tsukioka 宅邸。庭园里到处是颜色不对的圣诞树,说明这家人对节日缺乏理解。

lines.en: : Didn’t you have to go eat?
lines.zh: : 你不是要去吃饭吗?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf5
: Huh?
: Not you. Malvin. He’s a-
lines.zh: : 不是你。Malvin。他是个——

lines.en: : Shhh! Don’t let her know you talk to monks!
lines.zh: : 嘘!别让她知道你会跟修道士说话!

lines.en: : ...really great guy.
lines.zh: : ……非常好的家伙。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf6
: Oh, crap.
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf7
: Ah! At long last, the two of you have finally shown up.
lines.zh: : 啊!你们两个总算出现了。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf8
: Hi, Jeeves! And good evening to you, other rich girl!
lines.zh: : 嗨,Jeeves!还有祝你晚安,另一个有钱人家的姑娘!

lines.en: : Tsukasa and I were just getting some air. The rest of the class is in the golden room right now.
lines.zh: : 我和 Tsukasa 刚出来透透气。班上其他人现在都在黄金厅里。

lines.en: : Do you remember how to get there, Sensei? Mother {i}did{/i} show you the way, correct?
lines.zh: : 你还记得怎么去吗,Sensei?母亲应该给你带过路吧?

lines.en: : Yeah. I think that’s the one she said that I’m supposed to marry you in.
lines.zh: : 记得。我想就是她说我该在里面跟你结婚的那间。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf9
: That...would be the room I am referring to, yes.
lines.zh: : 那……正是我说的那间房,没错。

lines.en: : You can always have me instead if you want, Jeeves! That way, we’d be able to have fun together every day! And I’d become part-poor person!
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意,Jeeves,我也可以代替她!那样我们就能天天一起玩了!而且我还能变成半个穷人!

lines.en: : Sorry, Tsukasa. Sensei has already agreed to marry me. But you can be the flower girl if you want!
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Tsukasa。Sensei 已经答应娶我了。不过你想当花童也可以!

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf10
: I respectfully decline your offer. Gardening is a peasant’s job. But I’ll see to it that your venue is properly taken care of if you’re married outside of the golden room.
lines.zh: : 我恭敬地谢绝你的好意。园艺是下等人的活。不过如果你们不在黄金厅举行婚礼,我会负责把场地打理妥当。

lines.en: : Please tell me you remember that she’s your responsibility from this point on? I’m at my wit’s end here and I’ve barely even {i}spoken{/i} to Yasu today.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我你还记得,从现在起她就是你的责任了吧?我已经束手无策了,而今天我连跟 Yasu {i}说{/i}上几句话都算勉强。

lines.en: : Sorry, Touka. Unlike your mother, I don’t work holidays.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Touka。我可不像你母亲,节假日我是不工作的。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf11
: Work? Mother isn’t working today. She’s at a romantic ski resort with Father right now.
lines.zh: : 工作?母亲今天没有工作。她这会儿正和父亲在一个浪漫的滑雪场。

lines.en: : {i}Shh!{/i}
Oh. Apparently this is supposed to be a secret.
lines.zh: 哦。看来这应该是个秘密。

lines.en: That’s something I probably should have been informed of.
lines.zh: 这件事我本来大概是应该被告知的。

lines.en: : ...Yes. I just mean that skiing is very hard work and that only the...most distinguished and talented of people can manage such a task.
lines.zh: : ……对。我只是说滑雪是很辛苦的活,只有……最杰出、最有天赋的人才做得到。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf12
: I never thought it was hard. Is skiing supposed to be difficult, Onee-sama?
lines.zh: : 我从来不觉得难。滑雪是很难的事吗,Onee-sama?

lines.en: : I believe Sensei is just being polite. One seldom forgets how to ski once they’ve learned. And even if it’s decades ago at this point, I’m sure he has fond memories of his time at...whatever ski resort the commoners use.
lines.zh: : 我想 Sensei 只是客气。人一旦学会了滑雪,就很少会忘记。而且就算那是几十年前的事了,我相信他对在……平民们去的那个滑雪场度过的时光,也一定有着美好的回忆。

lines.en: : My house is on a hill. Does {i}that{/i} count?
lines.zh: : 我家在山坡上。{i}那{/i}算吗?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf13
: I’m not sure. I’d have to see it in the snow.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我得看看它下雪时的样子。

lines.en: : We have a slope in the south wing of the manor if you want to practice, Jeeves! I’m sure one of the other Jeeves’ can find some equipment that fits you!
lines.zh: : Jeeves,你要是想练习,我们宅邸的南翼有个坡!我敢肯定,其他某位 Jeeves 能给你找到合身的装备!

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf14
: An...excellent idea, Tsukasa! Buuuuut...wouldn’t you rather spend Christmas with the girls in my class this year? You were so adamant about coming, after all.
lines.zh: : 这真是个……绝妙的主意,Tsukasa!不——过……你今年不是更想和我班上的女孩们一起过圣诞吗?毕竟你那么坚持要来。

lines.en: : I’m really only interested in Jeeves. Everyone else is kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 我真的只对 Jeeves 感兴趣。其他人都挺怪的。

lines.en: : And...And he {i}isn’t?{/i} Besides, the south wing is miles away from here and-
lines.zh: : 可……可他{i}就不怪吗{/i}?再说了,南翼离这儿有好几英里远,而且——

lines.en: : Skiing sounds fun and all, but I probably {i}should{/i} see how everyone else is doing. They typically expect me to at least {i}show up{/i} to gatherings like this.
lines.zh: : 滑雪听起来是挺好玩的,不过我大概{i}该{/i}去看看其他人怎么样了。这种聚会,他们通常好歹指望我能{i}露个面{/i}。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf15
: Plus, Ayane and I are already pretty late. For extremely reasonable...reasons, of course.
lines.zh: : 再说,我和 Ayane 已经迟到了不少。当然是因为非常合理的……原因。

lines.en: : There was...a lot of traffic on the way here. We only met up about an hour ago.
lines.zh: : 来的路上……堵得厉害。我们大概一小时前才碰上面。

lines.en: : Yeah. It would have been weirder to meet up early since Ami and Niki have been out of the house all day and I don’t like being alone with girls.
lines.zh: : 是啊。早点碰面反而更奇怪,因为 Ami 和 Niki 一整天都不在家,而且我不喜欢单独跟女孩待着。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf16
: Oh, Jeeves. Aren’t you a little too {i}old{/i} to be getting nervous about things like that? I swear, it’s like you people become less and {i}less{/i} advanced every time I encounter you.
lines.zh: : 哦,Jeeves。你年纪是不是有点{i}太大{/i}了,还会为这种事紧张?我发誓,每次见到你们这些人,都觉得你们{i}越来越不先进{/i}了。

lines.en: : Meanwhile, I will elect to keep my mouth closed as {i}my{/i} mind has matured to the point where I am {i}able{/i} to pick up on context.
lines.zh: : 与此同时,我选择闭嘴,因为{i}我的{/i}头脑已经成熟到{i}能{/i}读懂语境了。

lines.en: Ayane elbows me in the side and lets out a sigh. She’s probably upset that Touka was able to see through my expertly plotted ruse.
lines.zh: Ayane 用手肘捅了我的侧腰,叹了口气。她大概是因为 Touka 看穿了我精心策划的托词而不高兴。

lines.en: I elbow her back. She’s probably turned on now. It doesn’t take much for her.
lines.zh: 我也用手肘回敬她。她现在大概已经兴奋了。对她来说这不需要多少刺激。

lines.en: scene black
: {i}Ahem.{/i} At the risk of you two flirting any longer, allow me to show you the way to the party. Come, Tsukasa. And stay close.
lines.zh: : {i}咳{/i}。冒着你们俩继续调情下去的风险,请允许我带你们去派对现场。来吧,Tsukasa。跟紧点。

lines.en: : Yes, Onee-sama. Come, Jeeves! Come, other girl!
lines.zh: : 好的,Onee-sama。来吧,Jeeves!来吧,另一个女孩!

lines.en: : We’ve had our interior decorators learn from the mistakes they made with my apartment to perfectly replicate a peasant Christmas! I’m sure you’ll find it to your liking.
lines.zh: : 我们让室内设计师从他们在我公寓犯下的错误里吸取教训,完美复刻了一个平民的圣诞节!我相信你会喜欢的。

lines.en: : And I’m sure it will be nothing even remotely close.
lines.zh: : 而我敢肯定,它会差得十万八千里。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf17
: Oh. You know, I guess this {i}is{/i} kind of close if you can look past this room itself being worth more than my house.
lines.zh: : 哦。你知道吗,如果你能忽略这间屋子本身就比我家还值钱这一点,那它其实还挺像的。

lines.en: : Yeah, it reminds me a lot of the parties we have at my house. Just with less stuff.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这让我很想起我家办的派对。就是东西少点。

lines.en: : In all fairness, you seem to have what could only be referred to as an obscene amount of “stuff” at your mansion, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话,Ayane,你宅邸里的「东西」多得只能用一个下流的词来形容。

lines.en: : Yeah. I basically only use my money on Halloween decorations and guns.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我的钱基本只花在万圣节装饰和枪上。

lines.en: : That’s like Onee-sama with horses.
lines.zh: : 就像 Onee-sama 和马一样。

lines.en: : And you with stuffed animals.
lines.zh: : 还有你和毛绒玩偶。

lines.en: : I like how everyone has just accepted Ayane’s addiction to firearms despite them being highly illegal in Japan.
lines.zh: : 我很喜欢大家都默认接受了 Ayane 对枪械的痴迷,尽管枪在日本是严重违法的。

lines.en: : Me too. It keeps the police off my back.
lines.zh: : 我也是。这样警察就不会找我的麻烦。

lines.en: : Jeeves, be on guard. There’s a small group of peasants attempting to swarm you.
lines.zh: : Jeeves,小心。有一小群平民正试图围住你。

lines.en: : Yeah, that happens.
lines.zh: : 是啊,经常这样。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf18
: Stop!
lines.zh: : 站住!

lines.en: : Hey, who invited you guys?
lines.zh: : 嘿,谁请你们来的?

lines.en: : You did, Akira! We’re the manifestation of your ability to cope with your loss of innocence through the correlation of cartoon characters to much-needed distractions from reality!
lines.zh: : 是你啊,Akira!我们是你那种能力的化身——你把卡通人物和急需的现实逃避联系在一起,借此应对自己失去的纯真!

lines.en: : That’s so on the nose that I think I’m starting to suffocate.
lines.zh: : 这也太直白了,我觉得我快窒息了。

lines.en: : You were never good at breathing!
lines.zh: : 你从来就不擅长呼吸!

lines.en: : Suffocation is precisely what all of this is! This endless smothering by indecision and a desire to get better, weighed down further by the hatred of who you are and what you’ve become!
lines.zh: : 窒息正是这一切的本质!优柔寡断和想要变好的欲望把你无休止地捂住,再加上对你自己是谁、变成了什么的憎恨,把你压得更沉!

lines.en: : {b}SPORK.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}SPORK。{/b}

lines.en: : Exactly! Which is precisely why you should throw yourself into perpetual uncertainty through camaraderie with this unending gallery of nubile flesh!
lines.zh: : 正是!所以你才该投身到这片无穷无尽的、年轻肉体画廊的兄弟情谊之中,把自己扔进永恒的不确定里!

lines.en: : That’s what I was {i}trying{/i} to do before you interrupted me. Now, go away. I want to see who wins the party game this time.
lines.zh: : 在你打断我之前,我本来就在{i}试着{/i}这么做。现在,一边去。我想看看这次谁会赢下派对游戏。

lines.en: : I just didn’t want you falling victim to one more scenario in which you encounter a presence you’re unsure of how to handle before tucking your tail between your legs and running off to hide in a public lavatory!
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你再落入这样的情境:遇到一个你不知道该怎么应对的存在,然后夹着尾巴逃去公共洗手间躲起来!

lines.en: : It’s elementary, dear Watson.
lines.zh: : 这很简单,亲爱的 Watson。

lines.en: : That’s not even the right {i}thing,{/i} Diamond.
lines.zh: : 这根本就对不上{i}号{/i},Diamond。

lines.en: : {b}SPORK.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}SPORK。{/b}

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i} Earth to Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}咳{/i}。Sensei,听得见吗?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf19
: Is the music too loud in here for you? Because if Miku is okay, I assumed you would be as well.
lines.zh: : 这里的音乐对你来说太吵了吗?因为如果 Miku 都还好,我猜你也应该没事。

lines.en: : Hiya, Sensei! I live to see another day! But I ain’t gonna clarify what I mean by that since Noriko’s here too!
lines.zh: : 嗨呀,Sensei!我又活过了一天!不过 Noriko 也在,所以我就不解释这话是什么意思了!

lines.en: : Hey! Merry Christmas. I promise I didn’t bring anything this year that is going to make you sad and nostalgic. Apart from my existence, that is. But I kind of can’t exist without that, so...
lines.zh: : 嘿!圣诞快乐。我保证今年没带任何会让你伤感和怀旧的东西来。除了我这个人以外。可我离了那点又没法存在,所以……

lines.en: : Hey, Noriko. Hey, Makoto. Please excuse me while I pick up Miku and claim her as my Secret Santa present for this year.
lines.zh: : 嘿,Noriko。嘿,Makoto。失陪一下,我要把 Miku 抱起来,认领成我今年的秘密圣诞老人礼物。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf20
: Yeah, I had the same reaction.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我也是这个反应。

lines.en: : Damn, Makoto! You really were right about this dress bein’ the nail in Sensei’s coffin. But how’re you gonna be able to compete now that you’ve given me all this power?
lines.zh: : 好家伙,Makoto!你说得真对,这条裙子就是钉死 Sensei 棺材的那颗钉子。可现在你把这种力量全给了我,你打算怎么跟我比?

lines.en: : I’ll figure something out. But for now, I’ll take solace in the fact that I was, once again, able to accentuate your cuteness in a way that only a best friend could.
lines.zh: : 我会想办法的。不过现在,我只能聊以自慰的是:我又一次以一种只有最好的朋友才能做到的方式,把你的可爱衬托了出来。

lines.en: : You gonna let me give {i}you{/i} a makeover next?
lines.zh: : 那下次你让我也给{i}你{/i}改造一下?

lines.en: : I would sooner die.
lines.zh: : 我宁可去死。

lines.en: : This isn’t everyone, is it? It looks like we’re still missing a few people.
lines.zh: : 这不是全部人吧?看起来还差几个。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf21
: Don’t look at me. Touka’s in charge of this event. And for once in my life, I’m actually able to hold myself back from taking the reins as {i}she{/i} is actually capable of doing such a thing.
lines.zh: : 别看我。这次活动是 Touka 负责的。而我有生以来头一回能忍住不去抢缰绳,因为{i}她{/i}确实有能力做好这件事。

lines.en: : Otoha’s on the way. I just talked to her a few minutes ago. But Ami’s with Nee-chan, right? Is she gonna try and show up later or-
lines.zh: : Otoha 在路上了。我几分钟前刚跟她说过话。可 Ami 是和 Nee-chan 在一起吧?她会不会晚点再来,还是——

lines.en: scene amisfunpartynight38
scene spaghettiscarf21
: Probably not. She’s felt kind of weird at parties ever since she stopped coming to school.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。自从她不来学校之后,她在派对上就总觉得有点怪怪的。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf22
: Really? But that was only for a little while. And she’s seemed totally normal lately.
lines.zh: : 真的吗?可那只是很短的一段时间啊。而且她最近看起来完全正常。

lines.en: : Almost {i}too{/i} normal. She barely even mentions you anymore.
lines.zh: : 正常得几乎{i}过头{/i}了。她现在连提都不怎么提你了。

lines.en: : In all fairness, she barely even {i}talks{/i} to anyone apart from Maya nowadays. But I think that’s mostly just because she still feels like we don’t accept her.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话,她现在除了 Maya 以外,几乎跟谁都不{i}说话{/i}。不过我觉得这多半只是因为她仍然觉得我们没有接纳她。

lines.en: : Well, do you?
lines.zh: : 那么,你们接纳了吗?

lines.en: : Define “accept.”
lines.zh: : 给「接纳」下个定义。

lines.en: : Ami’s kinda creepy, yeah. But love can make people act kinda weird, right? I ain’t got nothin’ against her. Even if she wants to do the naked disco with her uncle.
lines.zh: : Ami 是有点瘆人啦。可爱情会让人做出奇怪的事,对吧?我对她一点意见都没有。就算她想跟她叔叔来一场裸体迪斯科。

lines.en: : I don’t know much about whatever this “naked disco” Miku is talking about is, but I’ve come to understand that I just...will literally never understand Ami.
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚 Miku 说的这个「裸体迪斯科」是什么,不过我已经明白了,我……大概永远都不会懂 Ami。

lines.en: : She’s great sometimes and terrible others. But she’s still like family at the end of the day — which means it doesn’t really {i}matter{/i} how I feel about her.
lines.zh: : 她有时候很好,有时候很糟。可说到底她还是像家人一样——也就是说,我对她是什么感觉,其实并不{i}重要{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, regardless, she isn’t coming. And I think that’s what’s best for everyone.
lines.zh: : 好吧,不管怎样,她不会来。而且我觉得这对大家都好。

lines.en: scene black
show malvin
: Say, have any of you seen Malvin around here?
lines.zh: : 话说,你们有没有人在这儿见过 Malvin?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf23
: Pleeeeeeeease? I promise it only feels weird at first. After like five minutes, it’ll be {i}amazing.{/i} I promise.
lines.zh: : 求——求你啦?我保证只是一开始会觉得怪。过了大概五分钟,就会变得{i}超级棒{/i}。我保证。

lines.en: : Without knowing the context of what you’re suggesting, it sounds a lot like you’re trying to fuck me right now. Which would have been awesome like three years ago. Now, I’m just scared and mildly curious.
lines.zh: : 不知道你到底在提议什么的前提下,这听起来很像你现在想操我。要是放在三年前,那会很棒。现在嘛,我只是害怕,外加有点好奇。

lines.en: : Why do you...want Rin to dress up with you so badly anyway?...
lines.zh: : 话说你为什么……这么想让 Rin 陪你一起打扮?……

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf24
: I just think it’d be fun! Like, at first, I was only doing this because I wanted Sensei to notice me. But {i}now,{/i} I just genuinely think looking cute feels, like...totally freeing.
lines.zh: : 我就是觉得会很好玩!一开始我做这些只是想让 Sensei 注意到我。可{i}现在{/i},我是真心觉得,打扮得可爱这件事,感觉……特别自由。

lines.en: : And also because you still want Sensei to notice you.
lines.zh: : 也还是因为你想让 Sensei 注意到你。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s just a given now. Don’t tell anyone I said that, Sana.
lines.zh: : 是啊,不过现在这是理所当然的了。别跟别人说这话是我说的,Sana。

lines.en: : I think...we all kind of know already...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……大家其实都知道了吧……

lines.en: : Does that...really help, though? Do you think he looks at you more when you...wear things like that?
lines.zh: : 不过那……真的有用吗?你觉得你穿上那种衣服,他就会多看你几眼吗?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf25
: Mmm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: : Well, right now...no. But he’s {i}busy{/i} right now. So of {i}course{/i} he can’t focus on me and only me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,现在嘛……没有。可他这会儿{i}很忙{/i}。所以他{i}当然{/i}没法把注意力放在我身上,只放在我一个人身上。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf26
: Later, though? He totally will! And if he doesn’t, I just have to do something that’ll catch his eye! It’s like, totally easy! And even easier when you dress like this! Probably! Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 不过等会儿呢?他绝对会!要是他还是不看,我就做点能吸引他眼球的事!这超——简单的!而且穿成这样就更容易了!大概吧!哈哈哈!

lines.en: : You seem...kind of scary now, Chika...
lines.zh: : 你现在看起来……有点吓人,Chika……

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf27

: Why does everybody keep saying that? I’m like 1000%% normal and you guys keep acting like I’m turning into some creepy stalkery murdery girl or whatever. Is it the hair? Should I go back to blonde? Will that help?
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都这么说啊?我可有 1000%% 的正常,你们却一个个表现得好像我变成了什么跟踪狂杀人狂女孩似的。是头发的问题吗?我是不是该染回金色?那样会好点吗?

lines.en: : No, Chika. I think it’s the part where your voice is suddenly like two octaves higher than before. And how you keep giving everybody Noriko-eyes.
lines.zh: : 不是的,Chika。我觉得问题在于你的声音突然比以前高了快两个八度。还有你老是给所有人抛那种「Noriko 眼」。

lines.en: : Noriko-eyes? What the hell are Noriko-eyes?
lines.zh: : 「Noriko 眼」?那到底是什么鬼?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf28
: It’s when you open your eyes as wide as you can and smile so big that it hurts your cheeks. Like you’re really hamming up the whole “yandere” thing despite not actually being one at all.
lines.zh: : 就是把眼睛瞪到最大,笑得脸颊都疼。就像你在拼命卖力地演「病娇」那一套,尽管你根本就不是。

lines.en: : Even I can do it. I just try not to since I feel like I could get comfortable like this...
lines.zh: : 连我都能做到。我只是尽量不做,因为我感觉自己这样待久了会舒服得回不去……

lines.en: : Well, shit. That actually does look kind of creepy. Why is it normal for her, though?
lines.zh: : 我靠。那样看起来确实有点瘆人。可为什么她做起来就正常呢?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf29
: She’s probably just so nice that we’ve all learned to look past it by now. But it’s still weird when {i}you{/i} do it since you’ve always seemed so chill.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为她人太好了,我们早就学会了忽略这一点。可换成{i}你{/i}来做就很怪,毕竟你一直看着那么淡定。

lines.en: : Now, every day it’s like you’re one step closer to snapping and gouging out somebody’s eyes. It’s, like...totally creepy. And the Santa costume makes it like five times creepier.
lines.zh: : 现在,每天都像是你离崩溃、挖掉别人眼睛又近了一步。真的……超瘆人的。而且那身圣诞老人装让它瘆人程度翻了五倍。

lines.en: : So...fix my eyes. Got it. I can do that!
lines.zh: : 所以……把眼睛改掉。知道了。我做得到!

lines.en: : Bringing your voice back down would help too, I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得,把声音降回来也有帮助吧……

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf30
: Thanks, Sana. I’ll...
lines.zh: : 谢谢,Sana。我会……

lines.en: : Is there...a problem...Chika?...
lines.zh: : 有……什么问题吗……Chika?……

lines.en: : No, you just...
lines.zh: : 没有,你只是……

lines.en: : You {i}do{/i} look...really comfortable like that...
lines.zh: : 你那样子……看起来{i}真的{/i}很舒服……

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf31
On the other end of the room, beyond the reach of Malvin, Ayane Amamiya had made her way over to the meat puppet.
lines.zh: 在房间的另一头,Malvin 够不着的地方,Ayane Amamiya 已经走到了那具肉傀儡身边。

lines.en: : What do you want, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你想干什么,Ayane?

lines.en: But the meat puppet was currently mad because {i}she{/i} wanted to have sex with Akira all day and didn’t get to due to extenuating circumstances including (but not limited to) Ayane’s vagina.
lines.zh: 可这具肉傀儡现在正生着气,{i}因{/i}为她想和 Akira 做一整天的爱,却因为种种情有可原的状况没能如愿——这些状况包括但不限于 Ayane 的阴道。

lines.en: : I just wanted to see if you were okay. You’ve been really off ever since Halloween. And watching you just stand around all alone is making even {i}me{/i} uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 我只是想看看你还好吗。从万圣节之后你就一直很不对劲。而看着你一个人干站着,连{i}我{/i}都觉得不舒服。

lines.en: : Well, what else am I supposed to do? Ami isn’t here and neither were you and Sensei until a minute ago. The three of you are the only people I ever talk to.
lines.zh: : 那我还能怎么办?Ami 不在,你和 Sensei 一分钟前也都不在。你们三个是我唯一会说话的人。

lines.en: : Well, I guess {i}two{/i} of you now since getting Sensei to even {i}look{/i} at me has been hard lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯,现在大概只剩{i}两个{/i}了,因为最近连让 Sensei {i}看{/i}我一眼都很难。

lines.en: : Yeah...But that’s just because Sensei misses the {i}other{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 是啊……可那只是因为 Sensei 想念的是{i}另一个{/i}你。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf32
: Yeah! But he won’t talk to me about {i}that{/i} either! I even told him I’d be willing to try and learn! What else do I need to do?!
lines.zh: : 就是啊!可{i}这件事{/i}他也不肯跟我说!我甚至都告诉他,我愿意试着去学了!我到底还要怎么做?!

lines.en: : All this...stuff keeps happening and I’m seriously {i}trying{/i} to deal with it, but nothing is working!
lines.zh: : 这些……事情一件接一件地发生,我是真的在{i}努力{/i}应付,可什么都没用!

lines.en: : Like, what the fuck am I supposed to do to make things normal again, Ayane?! Am I gonna have to fuck {i}Ami{/i} for the rest of my life?!
lines.zh: : 说真的,我他妈到底该怎么做才能让一切恢复正常,Ayane?!难道我这辈子都得跟 {i}Ami{/i} 上床吗?!

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf33
: {i}What?...{/i}What would {i}that-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么?……{/i}那又能怎——

lines.en: : It’s a...figure of speech, okay?! I just have no idea how I’m supposed to compete with Niki! And I {i}thought{/i} I could compete with {i}you,{/i} but apparently {i}you’re{/i} also getting screwed like fifty times a day now!
lines.zh: : 那只是……个比喻,好吗?!我只是完全不知道该怎么跟 Niki 争!我本来{i}以为{/i}我还能跟{i}你{/i}争一争,可显然{i}你{/i}现在也一天被操五十次!

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf34
: And don’t even {i}say{/i} you’re not because I snuck in today and I {i}know{/i} what I heard.
lines.zh: : 还有,你别想说{i}没{/i}有,因为我今天偷偷溜进去过,我{i}知道{/i}我听到了什么。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you had to hear that, Maya. But...maybe you’d have better luck reaching him if you stopped leaning into the...sexual aspect of it all?
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉让你听到了那些,Maya。不过……如果你别再一头扎进这件事的……性那一方面,也许会更容易打动他?

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf35

: I mean...that’s obviously not the only part I care about. But {i}that’s{/i} the part that always reaches him. He gets all...depressing whenever we actually talk. And {i}I{/i} do too. So, like...what do I do, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 我是说……那显然不是我唯一在乎的部分。可那是唯一总能触动他的部分。每当我们真的谈心,他就会变得……很丧。{i}我{/i}也是。所以,那个……我该怎么办,Ayane?

lines.en: : Are you actually asking me for help?
lines.zh: : 你是在真的向我求助吗?

lines.en: : {i}Yes.{/i} I am {i}desperate{/i} at this point. And the time for rationality has apparently been tossed out of the window, so I’m willing to try {i}anything{/i} now. And I seriously mean anything.
lines.zh: : {i}对{/i}。我现在已经{i}走投无路{/i}了。而理智显然早就被扔出了窗外,所以现在我{i}什么都{/i}愿意试。我是认真的,什么都行。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf36
: It feels weird seeing you so...helpless.
lines.zh: : 看着你这么……无助,感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : I know. “The old Maya was always strong and confident and blah, blah, blah.” I am clearly not her. I may never {i}be{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 我知道。「以前的 Maya 总是又坚强又自信,吧啦吧啦吧啦。」我显然不是她。我也许永远都成不了她。

lines.en: : But if what you’ve told me is true, the one thing she and I {i}do{/i} have in common is that we both want the same thing. And it feels fucking weird when {i}I{/i} am the one standing in the way of that.
lines.zh: : 可如果你告诉我的都是真的,那她和我唯一共通的一点,就是我们想要的是同一样东西。而当站在中间挡路的人是{i}我{/i}的时候,那感觉他妈的怪极了。

lines.en: : You’d really try anything?
lines.zh: : 你真的什么都愿意试?

lines.en: : Yes. But I swear to god, if {i}you{/i} ask me to lure him back with a threesome as well and then the world starts repeatedly breaking until the two of us are making out, I’m just going to kill myself.
lines.zh: : 对。可我对天发誓,要是{i}你{/i}也让我用三人行把他勾回来,然后世界开始一遍遍崩坏,直到我们两个开始接吻,那我干脆去死算了。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf37
: What? No. I don’t want to make out with you.
lines.zh: : 什么?不。我可不想跟你接吻。

lines.en: : Not yet, you don’t. It’s only a matter of time, though. ‘Tis the season, Ayane. You’ll feel left out just like me soon enough.
lines.zh: : 现在是不想。不过只是时间问题。这正是那个季节嘛,Ayane。很快你就会跟我一样,觉得自己被落下了。

lines.en: : Maya...look at me.
lines.zh: : Maya……看着我。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf38
: You {i}know{/i} I want to help you. I practically {i}need{/i} you if I’m ever going to get to the bottom of this...timeline stuff. But I think you’re overestimating just what I can do here.
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}我想帮你。如果我还想弄明白这堆……时间线的事,我几乎非{i}需要{/i}你不可。可我觉得你高估了我在这儿能做的事。

lines.en: : I love Sensei. Everyone knows that. But the connection you two have runs way deeper than I’m able to reach. That’s been obvious ever since I figured it out. And I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我爱 Sensei。这一点谁都知道。可你们俩之间的羁绊,深到我根本够不着。从我想明白的那一刻起,这就很明显了。而我不……

lines.en: : I don’t want to hurt him, Maya. Nor do I want to risk winding up in the same predicament you have because it gives me one {i}more{/i} thing to claw through on the way to some kind of ending.
lines.zh: : 我不想伤害他,Maya。我也不想冒风险落到和你一样的处境,因为那会让我在通往某种结局的路上,又{i}多{/i}一件要用爪子刨开的东西。

lines.en: : And...I’m sure you two will find your way back to one another eventually. {i}Without{/i} my help. Which, frankly, wouldn’t be all that helpful in the first place as I exist in a part of his world that you don’t.
lines.zh: : 而且……我相信你们俩最终会自己找回彼此的路。{i}不需要{/i}我的帮助。说实话,我这点帮助本来也没多大用,因为我存在于他世界里一个你不在的角落。

lines.en: : So, basically, you’re telling me to go fuck myself.
lines.zh: : 所以,说白了,你是在叫我去操我自己。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t word it that harshly, but...I guess, in a way, I am.
lines.zh: : 我不会说得这么难听,不过……我想,从某种意义上说,是这样的。

lines.en: : It’s not because I want you to fail, though. I’m just...adapting the same strategy with you that I have with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 但这不是因为我想看你失败。我只是……在把对 Sensei 用的那套策略,同样用在你身上。

lines.en: : I will support you with all of my heart and all of my soul...but if I just keep dragging you guys where you want to end up, you’ll never figure out how to get there on your own. Do you know what I mean?
lines.zh: : 我会全心全意、用尽灵魂地支持你……可要是我一直把你们拖到你们想去的地方,你们就永远学不会靠自己走到那里。你明白我的意思吗?

lines.en: : Yeah. You mean you want me to fuck myself. Message received.
lines.zh: : 明白。你的意思就是想让我去操我自己。收到了。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf39
: Maya...
lines.zh: : Maya……

lines.en: : Time to go find a bathroom so no one has to see me do it in public, I guess. Later, Ayane. Thanks for nothing.
lines.zh: : 看来我得去找个洗手间,免得有人看见我在公共场合干那事。回头见,Ayane。真是谢谢你了,一点用都没有。

lines.en: scene spaghettiscarf40
scene black
: The two of them really {i}were{/i} made for each other, weren’t they?...
lines.zh: : 她们俩还{i}真是{/i}天生一对,不是吗?……
